misses.what: Security fix: an API key scoped to nothing or read-only could rename its owner's account via PATCH /api/v1/users/{username}; scoped credentials now need user.update.
API-key integrations that edit their own profile now get 403 unless scoped with user.update (and without rbac only superusers' keys can hold it). Browser sessions unaffected.
